answer: The wander of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The cedar holds work receipts rather than names, so the reef of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work.
